name: The Jewel Store Job
summary: Michael and Franklin rob the Vangelico jewellery store with Lester planning the job. It is the first heist and the player chooses between the Smart and Loud approaches.

attrs.money_reward: not validated yet (not listed on the source page)
attrs.unlock_requirement: Complete Casing the Jewel Store and the setup missions of the chosen approach

sections.title: How it unlocks
sections.text: Do Casing the Jewel Store, then complete the setup missions of the approach you want: Carbine Rifles for the Loud approach, or Bugstars Equipment and BZ Gas Grenades for the Smart approach. Once the setups are done, Lester's heist board lets you start the heist.

sections.title: Choosing an approach
sections.text: Smart is the stealthy gas-based entry (BZ gas grenades + disguises); Loud is the direct armed assault. Hired crew members cost a cut but reduce failures; cheaper crew may make mistakes that reduce the take. Exact take figures are not yet validated in the knowledge base.
